sentences.en: The long-awaited commission of enquiry report was released yesterday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 期待已久的调查报告昨天下午终于发布了。

sentences.en: I appreciate your answering my enquiry so promptly.
sentences.zh: 感谢您如此迅速地回答我的询问。

sentences.en: Police are conducting enquiries into what caused the train to leave the tracks.
sentences.zh: 警方正在调查导致火车脱轨的原因。
